name: Tsuma, Riko. Hajimete no Happening Bar Taiken 2
original_name: 妻、理子。はじめてのハプニングバー体験2
source:
The second chapter of the story of Riko's seduction by her not-husband Ikefuchi. 
Ikefuchi was a cad at the bar. But his brazen conquests went further than imagined. 
He enjoyed doing wives. At this bar such arrangements were easy. 
Riko is and has always been a loving wife... 
... with a loving husband, who brought her here, obsessed with a recent fantasy.

In this chapter, some even more hardcore plays await her...

translation:
这是莉子被非丈夫池渊诱惑的故事第二章。
池渊在酒吧里是个浪荡子，但他厚颜无耻的征服远超想象。
他喜欢玩弄有夫之妇。在这家酒吧，安排这种事很容易。
莉子一直是个深爱丈夫的妻子……
……她有一位深爱她的丈夫，是他带她来到这里，并沉迷于最近的幻想。

本章将等待她的是更加极端的玩法……
